resources.string:
RIFT could not save character lookup data to its local database. Your disk may be full, a storage quota may have been reached, or the database may not be writable.

Check available space on the drive containing the database and on your system temporary drive, and make sure RIFT can write to the database:
%1$s

Chat intel parsing will continue, but character lookups cannot be cached while this issue persists. Other local data, such as wallet history, may also fail to save.

After resolving the storage issue, restart RIFT. This warning will appear only once until RIFT is restarted.

RIFT could not load required files into temporary storage. Your disk may be full, a storage quota may have been reached, or the temporary directory may not be writable.

Free up space on the drive containing the temporary directory and make sure RIFT can write to it:
%1$s

After resolving the storage issue, restart RIFT.
